about.title: About Us
about.heroSubtitle: Founded in October 2002 — Jakarta's specialist for high-grade welding consumables and exotic alloys.
about.storyP1: PT Alfa Metalindo Indonesia was founded in October 2002 by Widiarty Wirawan in Jakarta Utara with a clear mission: to bring world-class welding consumables and exotic alloys to Indonesia's industrial sector — and to become the most trusted partner for the country's most demanding projects.
about.storyP2: Over more than two decades, Alfa Metalindo has grown into what we believe is Indonesia's leading distributor of high-grade welding consumables to the oil & gas sector. Our clients include Pertamina, PGN, Total, BP, ConocoPhillips, Medco E&P, Hess, PetroChina, CNOOC, and APD Serica Energy — names that demand only the highest quality and supply reliability.
about.storyP3: We operate from our office at Komplek Rukan Mahkota Ancol, Jakarta Utara. With over 100 projects supplied and 13 global brand partnerships, we bring both the product range and the technical expertise to support your most critical welding requirements.
about.visionText: "A Better Welding Partner" — to be the most trusted and technically capable welding consumable supplier in Indonesia, valued for quality products, expert support, and reliable delivery.
about.value1Desc: We only stock products from manufacturers with proven track records in the most demanding industrial applications.
about.value2Desc: Our team understands the metallurgy behind every product we sell — not just the catalog numbers.
about.value3Desc: We build long-term relationships with our customers, not just transactions.
about.value4Desc: Extensive inventory management ensures products are available when your project schedule demands it.
about.teamNote: Supported by dedicated teams in Marketing, Sales Engineering, Technical Support, and Accounting.

products.servicesSubtitle: We don't just supply consumables — we support your project from specification to execution.
products.service1Desc: Pressurized safety enclosures for live offshore and hot-work environments. WorkSafe habitats allow safe welding in classified areas without plant shutdown.
products.service2Desc: Rental and on-site PWHT services using our own Alfa PWHT Systems equipment. Stress-relief and code-compliant heat treatment for pressure vessels and pipelines.
products.service3Desc: Tri Tool cold-cutting and bevelling machines for precise pipe end preparation — no heat, no distortion, fit-for-purpose in classified areas.

industries.title: Industries
industries.subtitle: Two decades of experience supplying critical welding materials across Indonesia's most demanding sectors.

oil.name: Oil & Gas
oil.desc: Upstream and downstream applications requiring the highest integrity welds. We supply Duplex, Super Duplex, and Nickel alloys for corrosive and high-pressure O&G environments.

petrochem.name: Petrochemical
petrochem.desc: Reactors, towers, and heat exchangers where Duplex, Super Duplex, and Nickel alloys are essential for long-term integrity.

lng.name: LNG
lng.desc: Cryogenic applications demanding Nickel alloys, 9% Ni steel consumables, and stainless steels with proven low-temperature toughness.

fertilizer.name: Fertilizer
fertilizer.desc: Ammonia and urea plant environments requiring corrosion-resistant alloys and heat-resistant consumables for reactors and vessels.

power.name: Power
power.desc: High-temperature service in boilers and turbines where Nickel-based and high-temperature alloys deliver reliable long-term performance.

cement.name: Cement
cement.desc: Wear-resistant and hard-surfacing consumables (Welding Alloys) for kiln liners, rollers, and other high-abrasion components.

steel.name: Steel Plants
steel.desc: Heavy structural welding consumables for steel plant fabrication and maintenance, including hard-surfacing for wear parts.

sugar.name: Sugar Plants
sugar.desc: Corrosion and wear-resistant solutions — including Lincoln Electric Lincore hard-surfacing — for sugar processing equipment maintenance.
